content.text: Let me run a robustness fuzz test with random byte mutations to ensure we always exit 0 with valid JSON.

arguments.command:
cat > /app/tmp/work/fuzz.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, random, subprocess, sys, os

base = open('/app/examples/ambiguity.json','rb').read()
base2 = json.dumps(json.load(open('/app/tmp/work/big.json'))).encode()[:200000]
rng = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0)
N = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 800
bad = 0
counts = {}
for i in range(N):
    src = base if rng.random()<0.7 else base2
    data = bytearray(src)
    ops = rng.randint(1,6)
    for _ in range(ops):
        kind = rng.choice(['flip','ins','del','trunc','dup'])
        if not data: break
        p = rng.randrange(len(data))
        if kind=='flip':
            data[p] = rng.randrange(256)
        elif kind=='ins':
            data[p:p] = bytes([rng.randrange(256)])
        elif kind=='del':
            del data[p]
        elif kind=='trunc':
            del data[p:]
        else:
            data[p:p] = data[max(0,p-20):p]
    if rng.random()<0.1:
        data = b'\xef\xbb\xbf' + bytes(data)
    p = subprocess.run(['/app/submission/run.sh'], input=bytes(data), capture_output=True, cwd='/app/submission')
    if p.returncode != 0:
        bad += 1
        print('NONZERO EXIT', p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[:600])
        open('/app/tmp/work/fuzzfail_%d.bin'%i,'wb').write(bytes(data))
        if bad>3: break
        continue
    try:
        r = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    except Exception as e:
        bad += 1
        print('BAD JSON OUT', p.stdout[:200], e)
        open('/app/tmp/work/fuzzfail_%d.bin'%i,'wb').write(bytes(data))
        if bad>3: break
        continue
    if isinstance(r, dict) and 'error' in r:
        assert set(r.keys())=={'error'}, r
        assert r['error'] in ('E_LIMIT','E_JSON','E_SCHEMA'), r
        counts[r['error']] = counts.get(r['error'],0)+1
    else:
        assert set(r.keys())=={'version','classes','queries'}, r.keys()
        counts['ok'] = counts.get('ok',0)+1
    if len(p.stderr) > 0:
        counts['stderr'] = counts.get('stderr',0)+1
        if counts['stderr'] < 3:
            print('STDERR:', p.stderr.decode()[:400])
print('fuzz done bad=',bad, counts)
PYEOF
cd /app/tmp/work && timeout 1700 python3 fuzz.py 1 900 2>&1 | tail -12
